declaration.argument: Only how struct-shaped values are held changes: a map literal whose keys are distinct string literals, at most 15, each at its own slot of the map's root node, is stored as a slice of field values under an interned shape instead of a hash map, so building it hashes no key and allocates no map node, and a field read finds its position instead of hashing. Every observation of such a value - equality, ordering, signature under both hashing policies, hash, text, JSON and debug output, iteration, and any store with a key outside the shape - is that of the map the literal would have built, and a map rebuilt from the fields is node for node the same map under later inserts and removals. No draw, value, row, container order or anything the search reads changes. One-thread identity against the baseline binary on VR (3,008 runs), Mencius (2,160 runs), a crash-heavy session (1,800 runs) and a caps-engaged VR session of 100,000 runs: all four tables identical both ways, same stall_cap_runs.csv hashes, equal end reasons, steps and cap figures, runs_failed 0; baseline minus candidate value_sig.leaf_hashes_deferred equals value_struct.key_hashes_avoided minus fallback_key_hashes exactly on every run.
